entries.detail: Evidence lookup, claim tables, reason strings; verdict per needed capability executes capability_eligible.
Integer budget/availability verdict executes resource_gate; facts contract unchanged.
Granted-AND-covered verdict executes tool_admission; reason text host-side.
mncs/harness_routing.mncs executed via mncs_exec on every route.
mncs/harness_routing.mncs needs_coder executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_policy.mncs executed via mncs_exec; host encodes shell/python/git/path observations.
mncs/harness_policy.mncs evaluate_write executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_verdict.mncs dominate/combine4/combine8 executed; host chunks envelopes.
mncs/harness_atlas.mncs fold_pair/fold4/dispatch_gate/tool_admission executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_pins.mncs shape table + fail-closed admission executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_fabric.mncs precedence + dispatch gate executed via mncs_exec.
Generic fold_readiness<N> over concrete fold4/fold8 envelopes executed via mncs_exec.
mncs/harness_eligibility.mncs capability/resource gates executed via mncs_exec.
Primary classification + coder chain execute the routing kernel; availability mapping host-side.
Pin admission executes admit_placement; reason prefixes host-side.
Overall verdict executes fold_readiness; warnings stay host-side.
Classification + dispatch gate execute the fabric kernel; version parsing host-side.
Pin shape table executes pin_fields_valid; string content checks host-side.
Command ordering executes command_reason; lexing/paths host-side.
Write decision executes the policy kernel.
Verification acceptance folds through combine; subprocess checks host-side.
Duplicate-decision fold executes fold(); reasons/outstanding host-side.
Final target comparison executes dispatch_gate; freshness/signature host-side.
